body-control.purpose: Desktop controls and compact workbench chrome.

data.purpose: Quantities, money, dates, shortcodes, and aligned values.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Popover, menu, dialog, and sheet planes only.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Small overlay and toast state changes.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The leading action on a surface; grows to a 44px phone target.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--brand-cobalt, #2563eb); color: var(--brand-on-accent, #fff); font: 500 12px/18px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-ultramarine-dark, #1d4ed8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--brand-cobalt, #2563eb); } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-btn-primary { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Outline button
components.description: A quiet secondary action on a white working plane.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--brand-hairline, #d9dee7); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--brand-surface, #fff); color: var(--brand-graphite, #171a21); font: 500 12px/18px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--brand-inset, #f1f4f8); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-cobalt, #2563eb); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Neutral field with a crisp cobalt focus state.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--brand-hairline, #d9dee7); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--brand-surface, #fff); color: var(--brand-graphite, #171a21); font: 400 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand-cobalt, #2563eb) 45%, transparent); border-color: var(--brand-cobalt, #2563eb); } @media (max-width: 639px) { .ds-input { height: 44px; font-size: 16px; } }

components.name: Status chip
components.description: Compact status wording with a redundant border and tint.
components.css: .ds-status-positive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 20px; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand-positive, #16845b) 30%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand-positive, #16845b) 10%, transparent); color: var(--brand-positive, #16845b); font: 500 10px/14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Bounded panel
components.description: A normal-density white working region with no resting shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--brand-hairline, #d9dee7); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--brand-surface, #fff); color: var(--brand-graphite, #171a21); font: 400 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font: 600 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--brand-graphite-secondary, #667085); }

components.name: Domain navigation item
components.description: Stable domain wayfinding on a quiet rail.
components.css: .ds-domain-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 32px; gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--brand-graphite, #171a21); font: 500 13px/18px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-domain-nav:hover { background: var(--brand-inset, #f1f4f8); } .ds-domain-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-cobalt, #2563eb); } .ds-domain-mark { width: 2px; height: 16px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--brand-domain-pantry, #16845b); } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-domain-nav { min-height: 44px; } }

narrative.overview: Cubby is light-mode household operating software: records are stations, verified relationships are routes, and dense workbenches move a person from attention to evidence to action. Porcelain-white planes and cool rules keep data calm while cobalt interaction and five stable domain lines make the system navigable.
keyCharacteristics: Light-only Porcelain planes and graphite type
Dense read-heavy grids with normal-density surrounding content
Cobalt interaction and five stable domain lines
Truthful direct relationships before derived evidence
Docked wide-desktop context and canonical phone routes

rules.name: The Three Channels Rule
rules.body: Interaction, domain identity, and status each keep a separate color meaning.

rules.name: The Calm Grid Rule
rules.body: Large data surfaces remain neutral; meaningful state and selection carry color.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Inter speaks and JetBrains Mono measures.

rules.name: The Resting Plane Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces separate with tone or a hairline; shadow is reserved for temporary overlays.

dos: Keep tables dense and ordinary content at normal density.
Show direct relationships before derived evidence and label provenance.
Provide 44px phone targets and bounded internal scrolling.
Distinguish loading, empty, error, permission, disabled, and offline states.
donts: Do not revive warm-paper colors, 3px ink rules, or square rubber-stamp geometry.
Do not use domain color as status or destructive red as decoration.
Do not cardify every record or squeeze desktop grids into phone viewports.
Do not invent relationships, inventory automation, or spend metrics.
